vo.en: Pick a vegetable in three seconds.

visual.description: A man's hand pointing directly at the camera with an urgent, authoritative gesture.

vo.en: Do this math fast. Two plus two? Four plus four? Eight plus eight? Sixteen plus sixteen?

visual.description: A man quickly writing mathematical equations on a dusty chalkboard.

vo.en: Stop. Now, shout out the very first vegetable that pops into your head!

visual.description: An abstract 3D visualization of a human brain pulsing with bright blue light.

vo.en: Wait, the creepy part is I already knew what you'd choose.

visual.description: An extreme macro close-up of a human eye with the pupil dilating rapidly.

vo.en: It's called heuristic priming. When your brain is overloaded with rapid logic, it defaults to the most basic prototype.

visual.description: Intricate mechanical clock gears and cogs rotating in a complex system.

vo.en: You thought of a carrot. Am I right? Your mind took the path of least resistance.

visual.description: A fresh bunch of bright orange carrots with green tops lying on a wooden table.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment YES if this worked on you. This works because you...

visual.description: A close-up of a person's thumb tapping a smartphone screen repeatedly.
